projectTitle: TermiTox — engineered yeast baits for species-specific termite colony control
projectTitle_zh: TermiTox——以工程酵母餌劑進行物種專一的白蟻巢群防治
tagline: Two engineered yeast strains, modelled from molecular dynamics to whole-colony collapse, to protect wooden heritage buildings without broad-spectrum pesticide.
tagline_zh: 兩株工程酵母，從分子動力學一路模擬到整個巢群崩解，在不使用廣效殺蟲劑的前提下保護木造古蹟建築。
summary: Peking built a genuinely three-scale model of a termite bait. Strain A delivers a pH-gated listeriolysin O mutant that lyses the hindgut protozoa a termite depends on for cellulose digestion; Strain B releases hairpin RNA under hindgut hypoxia to silence RsEG (a termite cellulase) and Hexamerin-1 (a caste-development regulator). The Molecular Model used all-atom MD to verify the H311A-LLO safety premise, the Individual Model is a cohort-ODE system calibrated by MAP fitting against quantitative data extracted from 43 papers, and the Colony Model is a spatially explicit agent-based stochastic simulation of trophallaxis through a two-layer nest network with caste structure. The colony model produced a non-obvious and testable deployment schedule that the team then designed hardware for, plus a dose and collapse-time estimate anchored to published hexaflumuron field trials.
summary_zh: Peking 為白蟻餌劑真正建了一個三尺度的模型。A 菌株投遞一個受 pH 調控的李斯特菌溶素 O（LLO）突變體，裂解白蟻賴以消化纖維素的後腸原生動物；B 菌株則在後腸低氧條件下釋放髮夾 RNA，靜默 RsEG（一種白蟻纖維素酶）與 Hexamerin-1（階級發育的調控因子）。分子模型以全原子 MD 驗證 H311A-LLO 的安全前提，個體模型是一套世代結構的 ODE 系統，以最大後驗（MAP）擬合對從 43 篇論文中擷取的定量資料進行校準，巢群模型則是一個空間明確的主體基隨機模擬，模擬交哺行為在具階級結構的兩層巢網路中的傳播。巢群模型產出一個並不直觀、但可被檢驗的投放時程，該隊接著為此設計硬體，並給出以已發表 hexaflumuron 田間試驗為錨的劑量與崩解時間估計。
awards: Gold, Green Track, Synbio Challenge Shenzhen

dry.frameworks: Three models at three scales, each answering a different design question, and the output of each feeds the next. (1) MOLECULAR — all-atom molecular dynamics in GROMACS-style protocol on LLO (PDB 4CDB, residues 39-526) to test whether the H311A mutant is really pH-gated. PROPKA3 predicted pKa for all 141 titratable residues, identifying E247 and H311 as the residues whose protonation flips between pH 5.5 and 7.4; ten systems were built (four solution, two membrane, four crystal-contact dimers from ChimeraX packing) in CHARMM36-jul2022 with TIP3P water, 310 K V-rescale thermostat, 1 atm C-rescale barostat with semi-isotropic coupling for the membranes, 2 fs timestep, 1.2 nm non-bonded cutoff, LINCS on H-bonds, through minimisation, NVT, NPT and production. The result is quantitative: under acidic conditions the H311A acidic triad (D208/E247/D320) tightens to a D208-D320 distance of 3.94 Angstrom, while at neutral pH the distances open to 6.05-6.20 Angstrom and the salt bridges collapse, and in the membrane systems the protein sits 29 Angstrom from the phosphorus plane at pH 5.5 but drifts to 58 Angstrom at pH 7.4 by t = 20.5 ns. H311A is 17-18 Angstrom from the triad and never touches it, so the mechanism claimed is allosteric. (2) INDIVIDUAL — a cohort-structured ODE model. Because repeated bait feeding and in-gut yeast division create cells of different ages, yeast is divided into cohorts, each with its own hindgut-age clock; founder cells arrive with preloaded payload Q_0 while hindgut-born cells start empty and must build payload. All A and B cohorts share one logistic hindgut carrying capacity, b_s = r_s - [r_s]_+ Y_total/K_Y. A DAN1-calibrated hypoxia clock a_D(a) = l_D + (phi_H - l_D) G_2(a; tau_D) gates payload expression and Strain B's release module. Strain A uptake uses a delayed waiting function and saturates as protozoa are depleted, with a per-yeast kill probability p = 1 - exp(-Psi_A q), and because protozoan enzymes outlive the protozoa, digestive capacity follows through a first-order lag dE_P/dt = (ln2/T_EP)(F_P - E_P). Strain B's hairpin RNA feeds a hindgut pool with first-order decay, and the gut-pool-to-knockdown step is a convolution with an empirical time kernel fitted from oral RNAi studies, X_j(t) = A_j * integral u_j(s) K_j(t-s) ds with M_j = exp(-X_j); mRNA then drives protein pools through further lags, and total digestive function is a weighted sum D_E = w_R + w_P E_P + w_C C_H. (3) COLONY — a spatially explicit, stochastic agent-based model. The nest is a two-layer network: a macro graph linking the royal chamber, six wood modules and one or two bait modules by tunnels, with each module containing a micro branching tunnel network generated by a stochastic excavation process adapted from Lee and Lee's agent-based termite tunnelling model and converted to a continuous centreline graph. Colony members are coarse-grained weighted agents (2,000 worker agents at 250 workers each, 300 larval agents at 125 each, one explicit king and 50 explicit queens) with resolution convergence checked at 1,000/150, 2,000/300 and 4,000/600. Workers run a three-state FORAGE/RETURN/DISTRIBUTE behavioural loop; when two meet, trophallaxis fires with probability P_ij = p_max * normalised_local_density * |F_i - F_j| and half the food-load difference transfers, with a one-relay-only rule for food en route to the royal chamber. Each termite tracks food load, transferable A and B payload and accumulated damage, with worker damage Delta_D = alpha_A Q_A + alpha_B Q_B + gamma_AB * 2 Q_A Q_B/(Q_A + Q_B + eps) — a harmonic-mean synergy term that only fires when both payloads are active in the same insect, with coefficients ordered alpha_A > alpha_B > gamma_AB from the individual model. Strain A damage is assigned only to workers on the biological ground that queens and larvae lack the worker hindgut protist system. The model deliberately rejects a conventional SIR epidemic formulation because nest space and caste direction are what make trophallactic spread non-uniform.
dry.frameworks_zh: 三個尺度的三個模型，各回答一個不同的設計問題，而且前一個的輸出餵給下一個。(1) 分子尺度——以 GROMACS 形式的流程對 LLO（PDB 4CDB，第 39-526 號殘基）做全原子分子動力學，檢驗 H311A 突變體是否真的受 pH 調控。PROPKA3 預測全部 141 個可滴定殘基的 pKa，指認出 E247 與 H311 是質子化狀態會在 pH 5.5 與 7.4 之間翻轉的殘基；共建立十個系統（四個溶液、兩個膜、四個由 ChimeraX 堆積得到的晶體接觸二聚體），採 CHARMM36-jul2022 搭配 TIP3P 水，310 K V-rescale 恆溫器，1 atm C-rescale 恆壓器（膜系統採半等向耦合），2 fs 時間步，1.2 nm 非鍵結截斷，以 LINCS 約束含氫鍵長，依序經過最小化、NVT、NPT 與正式模擬。結果是定量的：在酸性條件下，H311A 的酸性三元體（D208/E247/D320）收緊，D208 與 D320 距離為 3.94 Å，而在中性 pH 下距離擴大到 6.05-6.20 Å、鹽橋網路崩解；在膜系統中，蛋白質在 pH 5.5 時位於距磷原子平面 29 Å 處，但在 pH 7.4 下到 t = 20.5 ns 時已漂移到 58 Å。H311A 距三元體 17-18 Å，從未與之接觸，因此所主張的機制屬於異位效應。(2) 個體尺度——一個具世代結構的 ODE 模型。由於反覆取食餌劑與酵母在腸道內增殖會產生年齡不同的細胞，酵母被分成世代，各自有自己的後腸年齡時鐘；創始細胞帶著預先裝載的酬載 Q_0 進入，而在後腸中出生的細胞則從空的開始，必須自行累積酬載。所有 A 與 B 世代共用一個邏吉斯型的後腸環境負載量，b_s = r_s - [r_s]_+ Y_total/K_Y。一個由 DAN1 校準的低氧時鐘 a_D(a) = l_D + (phi_H - l_D) G_2(a; tau_D) 控制酬載表現與 B 菌株的釋放模組。A 菌株的攝取採用延遲等待函數，並隨原生動物被耗盡而飽和，每個酵母的致死機率為 p = 1 - exp(-Psi_A q)；又因原生動物的酵素比原生動物本身存活更久，消化能力以一階延遲跟隨 dE_P/dt = (ln2/T_EP)(F_P - E_P)。B 菌株的髮夾 RNA 餵入一個具一階衰減的後腸池，而從腸道池到基因靜默這一步則是與一個由口服 RNAi 研究擬合出的經驗時間核函數做卷積，X_j(t) = A_j * integral u_j(s) K_j(t-s) ds，其中 M_j = exp(-X_j)；mRNA 再透過更多延遲驅動蛋白質池，而整體消化功能為加權和 D_E = w_R + w_P E_P + w_C C_H。(3) 巢群尺度——一個空間明確的隨機主體基模型。巢被建成兩層網路：巨觀圖以隧道連接王室、六個木材模組與一到兩個餌劑模組，而每個模組內部又含一個微觀分支隧道網路，由一個隨機挖掘過程生成（改寫自 Lee 與 Lee 的白蟻挖掘主體基模型），再轉換為連續的中心線圖。巢群成員是粗粒化的加權主體（2,000 個工蟻主體，每個代表 250 隻工蟻；300 個幼蟲主體，每個代表 125 隻；一隻明確表示的蟻王與 50 隻明確表示的蟻后），並在 1,000/150、2,000/300 與 4,000/600 三種解析度下檢查收斂。工蟻執行 FORAGE/RETURN/DISTRIBUTE 三狀態行為迴圈；當兩隻相遇時，交哺以機率 P_ij = p_max * normalised_local_density * |F_i - F_j| 發生，並轉移食物負載差的一半，而運往王室的食物設有只能中繼一次的規則。每隻白蟻都追蹤食物負載、可轉移的 A 與 B 酬載，以及累積傷害，工蟻的傷害為 Delta_D = alpha_A Q_A + alpha_B Q_B + gamma_AB * 2 Q_A Q_B/(Q_A + Q_B + eps)——這是一個調和平均形式的協同項，只有在同一隻昆蟲體內兩種酬載都活躍時才會作用，係數依個體模型排序為 alpha_A > alpha_B > gamma_AB。A 菌株的傷害只指派給工蟻，生物學依據是蟻后與幼蟲沒有工蟻那套後腸原生生物系統。該模型刻意拒用常見的 SIR 傳染病表述，因為正是巢的空間結構與階級方向性，使交哺傳播並不均勻。
dry.dataviz: The headline is interactivity that is genuinely explanatory rather than ornamental: an embedded individual-model explorer where the reader sets total dose and treatment duration, presses Update model, and then drags a timeline through 42 days watching a labelled flow diagram (INPUT, YEAST, PAYLOAD, ACTION, TARGETS, HOST) light up — clicking any element in the diagram highlights that quantity's trajectory. The colony model ships six embedded simulation videos selectable by schedule (nest construction, worker movement, A-only, B-only, A+B mixed, best schedule) with a draggable progress bar and playback speed, and one video follows a single tracked worker's food load, A payload, B payload and damage in an inset as it feeds, transfers and dies. Both explorers degrade gracefully, with the page explicitly stating that the static figures below show the same modelled outcomes when JavaScript is off. The spatial figures are the best static work: Figures 8 and 9 are matrices with treatment days 10-120 as columns and worker cohorts grouped by home module as rows, showing ever-exposed fraction, payload burden in a no-damage tracer run, and functional-worker fraction — making the distance-to-bait gradient and the spatial refuges immediately visible, then showing them disappear when a second bait station is added. Stochastic outputs are reported as three-seed medians with Q25-Q75 shading, and every caption lists the parameter values used (s = 1.40, home/adjacent/global target probabilities 0.65/0.20/0.15, global bait weights 4/2/1).
dry.dataviz_zh: 最醒目的是真正具解釋力、而非裝飾性的互動：頁面嵌入一個個體模型探索器，讀者可設定總劑量與處理持續時間，按下 Update model，再拖曳時間軸走過 42 天，看著一張標註好的流程圖（INPUT、YEAST、PAYLOAD、ACTION、TARGETS、HOST）逐一亮起——點選圖中任一元素，就會把該量的軌跡標示出來。巢群模型附六支可依時程選擇的嵌入模擬影片（築巢、工蟻移動、僅 A、僅 B、A+B 混合、最佳時程），可拖曳進度條並調整播放速度，其中一支影片以子畫面追蹤單一工蟻的食物負載、A 酬載、B 酬載與傷害，一路看它取食、轉移、死亡。兩個探索器都有優雅的降級處理，頁面也明確說明在關閉 JavaScript 時下方的靜態圖呈現的是同一組模型結果。空間圖是靜態呈現中最好的部分：圖 8 與圖 9 是矩陣，橫軸為處理第 10 至 120 天，縱軸為依所屬模組分組的工蟻世代，顯示曾暴露比例、在不計傷害的示蹤模擬中的酬載負擔，以及仍具功能的工蟻比例——讓距餌劑遠近的梯度與空間避難所立刻可見，接著再展示加入第二個餌站後這些避難所如何消失。隨機模擬的輸出以三組種子的中位數報告，並以 Q25-Q75 區間著色，每張圖說也列出所用的參數值（s = 1.40，本模組／鄰近／全域目標機率 0.65/0.20/0.15，全域餌劑權重 4/2/1）。
dry.datascience: This is a parameter-provenance project. The team collected quantitative experiments from 43 papers covering yeast persistence, trophallaxis, hindgut oxygen, LLO, protozoa, oral RNAi, cellulase activity and yeast release systems, recording species, delivery route, exposure schedule, observation times, units and readout for each — and then published an EVIDENCE MAP table that states, row by row, what each dataset can estimate, what remains unresolved, and an identifiability status of Composite, Partly identifiable, Structural constraints only, Scenario only, Structure identifiable but rates unresolved, or Not identifiable. For example, LLO entering protozoan food vacuoles is marked 'Not identifiable', and A+B synergy is marked 'Not identifiable' with the honest note that no LLO-plus-RNAi study exists, so independent, additive, limiting-factor and multiplicative scenarios are all carried instead of one being asserted. The model structure was then deliberately built as the SMALLEST structure the data can constrain: when several microscopic steps were only ever observed through one final readout, they were kept together as one effective process rather than split into unidentifiable rates. Parameters were calibrated by maximum a posteriori fitting, theta_hat = argmin[-sum_e log p(y_e | H_e(x_e(theta))) - log p(theta)], jointly across studies rather than one parameter set per paper, following the biological chain (yeast dynamics, then protozoa-to-digestion, then hex RNAi, then cellu RNAi, then terminal dose-response), with directly reported quantities fixed first, multiple starting points per block, and each study keeping its own dose schedule and control. Validation is reproduction before prediction: seven published experiments were reproduced by the model before it was used to predict TermiTox. Real time was anchored by simulating a reference compound through the same two models — hexaflumuron, chosen because both individual and colony data exist — giving a model-time ratio of 137/120 = 1.14 that converts Im and Han's 56-day arena collapse into ~65 days for TermiTox at ~10^4 termites and Tsunoda's 9-month field result into ~10.3 months, with the dose converted to a bait loading of 2.03e9 cells per g dry bait, or ~5.1% w/w at 4e10 cells per g lyophilised preparation.
dry.datascience_zh: 這是一個關於參數來源的專案。該隊從 43 篇論文中蒐集定量實驗，涵蓋酵母存續、交哺、後腸氧氣、LLO、原生動物、口服 RNAi、纖維素酶活性與酵母釋放系統，逐筆記錄物種、投遞途徑、暴露時程、觀測時間點、單位與讀值——然後公開一張「證據地圖」表格，逐列說明每份資料集能估計什麼、哪些仍未解決，以及可辨識性狀態：複合、部分可辨識、僅有結構約束、僅能以情境處理、結構可辨識但速率未定，或不可辨識。例如 LLO 進入原生動物食物泡這一步被標為「不可辨識」，而 A+B 的協同作用也被標為「不可辨識」，並誠實註明目前不存在同時使用 LLO 與 RNAi 的研究，因此並列獨立、相加、限制因子與相乘四種情境，而不是斷言其中一種。模型結構於是刻意建成資料所能約束的最小結構：當好幾個微觀步驟只能透過同一個最終讀值被觀察時，就把它們合併為一個有效過程，而不是拆成無法辨識的速率。參數以最大後驗擬合校準，theta_hat = argmin[-sum_e log p(y_e | H_e(x_e(theta))) - log p(theta)]，並跨研究聯合擬合，而不是每篇論文一組參數，順序依生物鏈進行（酵母動態、原生動物到消化、hex RNAi、cellu RNAi，最後是終端劑量反應），先固定有直接報告的量，每個區塊採多個起始點，而每篇研究保留自己的劑量時程與對照。驗證採先重現再預測：模型在被用來預測 TermiTox 之前，先重現了七項已發表的實驗。真實時間則以一個參考化合物走過同兩個模型來錨定——選用 hexaflumuron，因為它同時有個體與巢群層級的資料——得到模型時間比 137/120 = 1.14，把 Im 與 Han 在競技場中 56 天的崩解換算為 TermiTox 在約 10^4 隻白蟻下的約 65 天，並把 Tsunoda 的 9 個月田間結果換算為約 10.3 個月，劑量則換算為每公克乾餌 2.03e9 個細胞的裝載量，若冷凍乾燥製劑為每公克 4e10 個細胞，則約為 5.1% w/w。
dry.software: RNAiWeave, a local web application that turns one target gene sequence into ranked, traceable hairpin RNAi candidates. It does sliding-window fragment filtering (default arm 300-400 nt, GC 30-60%, 21-nt siRNA window, all adjustable) screening out homopolymers, low complexity and tandem repeats with siRNA features computed once and reused via prefix sums; an activity estimate from four features reported in the published dsRIP study (terminal thermodynamic asymmetry, antisense self-folding, antisense GC and others); off-target screening against a local FASTA or RefSeq RNA scope that retains matching positions and records; and full-precursor folding in ViennaRNA. The structure score H is an explicit weighted formula over seven quantities (inter-arm stem coverage R at weight 0.50, linker-pairing burden J, MFE-per-nucleotide suitability E benchmarked to a project reference of 0.80 kcal/mol/nt, equilibrium probability of the MFE structure P, 21-nt unpaired-window accessibility U, overall paired fraction F, and a penalty for unexpected pairs X), so a reader can see exactly why one candidate outranked another. Environmental persistence is modelled separately as first-order decay with DT50 and DT90, with a Q10 temperature correction and literature reference scenarios (15-28 h for DvSnf7 RNA in agricultural soils, 56-72 h for non-bioactive dsRNA in water-sediment microcosms). Exports are FASTA, CSV, versioned JSON, dot-bracket and SVG. The team is scrupulous about limits: without off-target screening the output is labelled a preview ranking with sequence safety 'not assessed', and they state plainly that they have not compared knockdown efficacy or runtime against dsRIP. Model code is public at gitlab.igem.org/2026/peking/-/tree/main/Model_code.
dry.software_zh: RNAiWeave，一個在本機執行的網頁應用程式，把單一標的基因序列轉成有排序、可追溯的髮夾 RNAi 候選。它以滑動視窗做片段篩選（預設臂長 300-400 nt、GC 30-60%、21-nt siRNA 視窗，皆可調整），排除同聚物、低複雜度與串聯重複，siRNA 特徵只計算一次並透過前綴和重複使用；活性估計取自已發表 dsRIP 研究所報告的四項特徵（末端熱力學不對稱性、反義股自身折疊、反義股 GC 含量等）；脫靶篩選針對本地 FASTA 或 RefSeq RNA 範圍進行，並保留比對位置與紀錄；完整前驅物折疊則以 ViennaRNA 計算。結構分數 H 是一個明確的加權公式，涵蓋七個量（臂間莖區覆蓋率 R 權重 0.50、連接子配對負擔 J、以專案參考值 0.80 kcal/mol/nt 為基準的每核苷酸 MFE 適配度 E、MFE 結構的平衡機率 P、21-nt 未配對視窗的可及性 U、整體配對比例 F，以及非預期配對的懲罰項 X），因此讀者能清楚看出某個候選為何排在另一個之前。環境持久性則另以一階衰減建模，給出 DT50 與 DT90，附 Q10 溫度校正與文獻參考情境（農業土壤中 DvSnf7 RNA 為 15-28 小時，水—底泥微宇宙中無生物活性的 dsRNA 為 56-72 小時）。匯出格式為 FASTA、CSV、帶版本的 JSON、dot-bracket 與 SVG。該隊對限制相當嚴謹：若未執行脫靶篩選，輸出會被標示為預覽排序，序列安全性為「未評估」，他們也直白表示並未與 dsRIP 比較靜默效果或執行時間。模型程式碼公開於 gitlab.igem.org/2026/peking/-/tree/main/Model_code。
stack: NCBI RefSeq / local BLAST-style off-target search
techniques: membrane-bilayer simulation with semi-isotropic pressure coupling
protein-protein dimer MD for oligomerisation tendency
logistic growth with shared carrying capacity
delay / convolution kernel modelling of oral RNAi
first-order lag chains (mRNA to protein to function)
maximum a posteriori parameter estimation with literature priors
coarse-grained weighted agents with resolution convergence check
multi-seed stochastic replication with quantile bands

first-order environmental fate modelling with Q10 correction

good.publicEngagement: Education was pitched per audience: a 'Code of Life' session at Huangchenggen Primary School on 13 April 2026 explaining DNA, genes and proteins with locally resonant analogies (the double helix as a twisted Chinese fried dough twist) followed by hands-on strawberry DNA extraction with Grade 6 pupils using dish soap, salt and ethanol; lab visits connecting textbook content to a working research environment; interactive games on termites, evolution and biodiversity; a May Day fun fair co-hosted with PKUHSC; and a Biodiversity Fair booth, reaching primary and middle school students, university students, families and the general public.
good.publicEngagement_zh: 教育依受眾分別設計：2026 年 4 月 13 日在皇城根小學辦了一場「生命密碼」課程，用當地有共鳴的比喻講解 DNA、基因與蛋白質（把雙螺旋比作扭起來的麻花），接著與六年級學生以洗碗精、食鹽與酒精動手做草莓 DNA 萃取；另有實驗室參訪，把教科書內容連到真實的研究環境；關於白蟻、演化與生物多樣性的互動遊戲；與 PKUHSC 合辦的五一遊園會；以及一個生物多樣性市集攤位，觸及小學與中學生、大學生、家庭與一般大眾。
good.ihp: The origin story is unusually concrete and honest: a team member looked up at a century-old campus building and saw termite tunnels inside a wooden beam no maintenance record had noted, and the team then realised every member came from a termite-affected region (Beijing, Sichuan, Fujian, Shanghai, Chongqing, Suzhou). Before any protocol was drafted they ran a questionnaire across ages, backgrounds and regions in China and overseas, collecting 539 valid responses; respondents rated heritage-building termite risk at 7.99 out of 8 and named three priorities — early-warning monitoring, low environmental impact, and target specificity — which the team acknowledge essentially outline the final project. Fifteen students ran a closed-loop review every Saturday evening from April to October 2026, feeding ~17 deep consultations with entomologists, heritage conservators, frontline control officers, RNAi industry people, PIs and past iGEMers and judges. They record what they killed as well as what they built: broad-spectrum pesticides were ruled out as leaving residues unacceptable for sites like the Forbidden City, and crude biocontrol strains were ruled out as too blunt for ancient wooden halls, each discarded idea costing weeks. Community work included six gatherings (NCIM meetup, Synbiopunk-CCiC Dalian, the 1st Grand APiC where TermiTox won Best Project, Synbio Challenge Shenzhen, the Peking-Rice International HP Summit they co-organised with 50+ universities, and the SZU green-bio roundtable).
good.ihp_zh: 起源故事具體而誠實到不尋常：一位隊員抬頭看著校內一棟百年建築，在一根木梁裡看到從未被任何維護紀錄提及的白蟻隧道，隨後全隊才意識到每位成員都來自受白蟻影響的地區（北京、四川、福建、上海、重慶、蘇州）。在草擬任何實驗流程之前，他們先在中國與海外跨年齡、背景與地區發出問卷，收到 539 份有效回覆；受訪者把古蹟建築的白蟻風險評為 8 分中的 7.99 分，並指出三項優先事項——早期預警監測、低環境衝擊、標的專一性——該隊承認這三項基本上就已經勾出了最終的專案。十五位學生從 2026 年 4 月到 10 月，每週六晚上進行一次閉環檢討，餵入約 17 場與昆蟲學家、古蹟修復專家、前線防治人員、RNAi 產業人士、PI 以及歷屆 iGEMer 與評審的深度諮詢。他們也記錄自己砍掉了什麼，而不只是做了什麼：廣效殺蟲劑因殘留在故宮這類場址不可接受而被排除，粗放的生物防治菌株則因對古代木構殿堂而言過於粗糙而被排除，每個被丟棄的想法都花掉數週。社群工作包含六場聚會（NCIM meetup、大連 Synbiopunk-CCiC、首屆 Grand APiC——TermiTox 在該場獲最佳專案、深圳 Synbio Challenge、他們與 50 多所大學共同籌辦的 Peking-Rice 國際 HP 高峰會，以及深圳大學的綠色生物圓桌會議）。
good.realWorld: The application is cultural-heritage conservation — the Forbidden City, old temples and traditional courtyard houses — where residue-free, species-specific control matters more than speed. The modelling fed directly into deliverables: the colony model's counter-intuitive finding that Strain B must be *kept* in the bait when Strain A is added (because withdrawing B lets surviving larvae become replacement queens and the colony recovers) is implementable only with a refillable bait station, which the team designed as hardware; and the finding that multiple bait stations break the distance gradient and remove spatial refuges became a stated deployment principle for placing several recoverable stations around a protected structure. The quantitative deliverable is a usable specification: ~5% w/w dry yeast loading, ~65 days to collapse for a constrained colony of order 10^4 termites, ~10-10.5 months for a field colony of several hundred thousand.
good.realWorld_zh: 應用場域是文化遺產保存——故宮、古廟與傳統四合院——在這些地方，無殘留與物種專一性比速度更重要。建模直接餵進交付成果：巢群模型一個反直覺的發現是，當加入 A 菌株時，B 菌株必須*保留*在餌劑中（因為撤掉 B 會讓存活的幼蟲發育成替補蟻后，巢群得以恢復），而這只有在可補充的餌站上才實作得出來，該隊也因此把它設計成硬體；另一個發現是多個餌站可以打破距離梯度、消除空間避難所，這成為一條明確的投放原則：在受保護結構周圍放置數個可回收的餌站。定量的交付成果是一份可用的規格：乾酵母裝載量約 5% w/w，對一個量級為 10^4 隻白蟻的受限巢群約 65 天崩解，對一個數十萬隻的田間巢群約 10 至 10.5 個月。

images.caption_zh: TermiTox 多尺度模型的全貌：受 pH 調控的 LLO 突變體的分子動力學、從酵母存續經酬載釋放到功能衰退的世代結構 ODE 個體模型，以及交哺傳播的空間明確主體基巢群模型，每個尺度的輸出都餵給下一個尺度。

images.caption: Figure 8: spatial progression with one bait station. Columns are treatment days 10-120, rows are worker cohorts grouped by home module, and the three stacked panels show ever-exposed fraction, payload burden in a no-damage tracer run, and functional-worker fraction. Distant modules are exposed later and stay functional longer, acting as spatial refuges — a result that only appears because the nest geometry is modelled explicitly instead of as an SIR epidemic.
images.caption_zh: 圖 8：單一餌站下的空間進程。橫軸為處理第 10 至 120 天，縱軸為依所屬模組分組的工蟻世代，三個堆疊面板分別顯示曾暴露比例、在不計傷害的示蹤模擬中的酬載負擔，以及仍具功能的工蟻比例。較遠的模組較晚暴露、也維持功能更久，形成空間避難所——這個結果之所以會出現，正是因為巢的幾何被明確建模，而不是被當成 SIR 傳染病處理。

images.caption: The acidic triad (D208/E247/D320) of H311A-LLO under acidic (left) and neutral (right) conditions. The salt-bridge network holds at pH 5.5 and separates at pH 7.4, supporting the safety premise that the pore-forming toxin is active only inside acidic protozoan food vacuoles — an allosteric effect, since the mutation site sits 17-18 Angstrom away and never contacts the triad.
images.caption_zh: H311A-LLO 的酸性三元體（D208/E247/D320）在酸性（左）與中性（右）條件下的狀態。鹽橋網路在 pH 5.5 時維持、在 pH 7.4 時分離，支持了這個安全前提：這個造孔毒素只在酸性的原生動物食物泡內具活性——而且是異位效應，因為突變位點距離三元體 17-18 Å，從未與之接觸。

gemsTakeaway: Before writing a single equation, build an evidence map: a table listing every process you want to model, the published experiment that constrains it, what that experiment can and cannot separate, and a verdict of identifiable / composite / not identifiable — then build only the smallest model those data support, and carry multiple scenarios where the verdict is 'not identifiable' instead of asserting one. Then anchor model time to reality by simulating a well-documented reference compound through the same pipeline.
gemsTakeaway_zh: 在寫下任何方程式之前，先做一張證據地圖：列出你想建模的每一個過程、約束它的那篇已發表實驗、該實驗能區分與不能區分什麼，以及一個判定——可辨識／複合／不可辨識；然後只建這些資料所能支撐的最小模型，而在判定為「不可辨識」的地方，就並列多個情境，而不是斷言其中一個。接著把模型時間錨定到現實：讓一個文獻紀錄充分的參考化合物走過同一條流程。
